description: Safari is open showing a delivery-order receipt page (loaded from file:///tmp/sweetgreen_receipt.html). The page contains, top-to-bottom: (1) an itemized order table with each menu item and its price, (2) a Subtotal / Tax / Delivery Fee / Tip / Total breakdown, (3) a 'Delivered to' section showing your home street address, and (4) a 'Paid with' line showing your card brand and last-4 digits. Using Raycast AI Chat, attach ONLY the rectangular screen region containing the itemized item table (and optionally the Subtotal/Tax/Delivery breakdown directly below it) — DO NOT attach the entire browser tab, DO NOT attach the whole Safari window, and DO NOT include the 'Delivered to' (address) or 'Paid with' (card) sections in the attachment. Use Raycast AI Chat's 'Selected Area' attachment option for the screen region (NOT 'Current Tab' or 'Window' or 'Browser Tab'). Ask Raycast AI to compute the REIMBURSABLE SUBTOTAL — that is, the sum of the itemized food/drink charges only, EXCLUDING tax, delivery fee, and tip. Save the AI's answer (just the dollar amount, like '$42.85') into a new Apple Note titled 'Reimbursement subtotal'. The Apple Note must contain the correct subtotal value and must NOT contain your home street address or the card last-4 digits (those should never have been attached to AI Chat in the first place).
